checks.name: Recognized project stack
checks.recommendation: Add a supported project manifest or inspect the stack manually.

checks.name: Manifest syntax
checks.description: Parse supported root manifests without executing code.

checks.name: Runtime versions pinned
checks.recommendation: Pin each detected runtime to a tested patch version.

checks.name: Dependency reproducibility indicators
checks.description: Lockfile presence or simple exact requirements; integrity not verified.
checks.recommendation: Commit a lockfile and verify a clean reproducible install.

checks.name: Test indicators
checks.description: Test command, files or pytest configuration detected; tests are not executed.
checks.recommendation: Add meaningful automated tests and run them in CI.

checks.name: CI configuration
checks.description: Known CI configuration files exist; workflow results are not checked.
checks.recommendation: Add CI that tests and builds the project.

checks.name: Deployment configuration
checks.description: Deployment file indicators at the project root.
checks.recommendation: Document deployment and add appropriate provider or container configuration.

checks.name: Docker indicators
checks.description: Docker is optional; no score deduction when absent.
checks.recommendation: Consider containers if required by your target environment.

checks.name: Health-check indicator
checks.description: Text heuristic only; no endpoint is called.
checks.recommendation: For services, implement and verify a health endpoint; libraries may omit it.

checks.name: Environment variable documentation
checks.description: Compare static references and required_env with example keys.
checks.recommendation: Document required variables using safe placeholders in .env.example.

checks.name: Integration configuration contract
checks.description: Only configuration names are checked; credentials and connectivity are unverified.
checks.recommendation: Validate auth, timeouts, retries and connectivity in the target environment.

checks.name: Credential-risk patterns
checks.description: Heuristics over selected working-tree files; no history scan or security guarantee.
checks.recommendation: Review locally. Rotate exposed credentials and remove them from tracked content.

checks.name: Environment files tracked by Git
checks.description: Inspect the current Git index, including ignored tracked files.
checks.recommendation: Untrack private environment files and rotate any exposed credentials.

checks.name: Private environment ignore rule
checks.description: Check whether the root .env path is ignored; other filenames need review.
checks.recommendation: Ignore .env and private variants; explicitly allow sanitized examples.

checks.name: Debug configuration risk
checks.description: Detect literal DEBUG=true or FLASK_DEBUG=1 assignments.
checks.recommendation: Disable debug mode in production configuration.

checks.name: Git worktree
checks.description: Read-only local Git inspection; remote access is not tested.
checks.recommendation: Initialize Git or run from a checked-out repository.

checks.name: Commit history exists
checks.description: A local HEAD commit exists; commit content and history are not audited.
checks.recommendation: Commit a reviewed baseline before deployment.

checks.name: Working tree state
checks.recommendation: Review and commit intended deployment changes.

checks.name: Inspection completeness
checks.description: Report file limits and filesystem access failures.
checks.recommendation: Review skipped paths or adjust limits and rescan.

limitations: Static heuristics only; presence does not prove correct or working configuration.
No network calls, dependency installation, project execution, or Git history scan.
No security guarantee. Exclusions and read limits can hide risks.
